topic: Luffy burned the World Government flag to make Robin say she wants to live, the answer to her fear of being a burden
title: Luffy Burned That Flag For One Sentence
description: At Enies Lobby, Sogeking burned the World Government flag so Robin would say one sentence. Here's why that scene answers the fear that made her walk through Blueno's door.
tags: nico robin i want to live
comment: Was burning the flag Luffy's smartest move or just his loudest? Pick one.

lines.text: Luffy had Sogeking burn the World Government flag to get one sentence out of Robin.

shot.fallback: boy pointing at a flag on a tower

lines.text: Robin has just told everyone she's a burden.
She's been betrayed so many times that she expects the Straw Hats to be next.
He points at the flag and says over 170 nations are after her.
Luffy doesn't argue. He tells Sogeking to shoot it.
The flag burns, and the Straw Hats have just declared war on the World Government.

shot.search: Enies Lobby flag burns declaration of war
shot.fallback: flag on fire above a tower

lines.text: Luffy says he can take it, then tells her to admit she wants to live.

shot.search: Luffy Robin I want to live

lines.text: Here's my read: he isn't rescuing her. He's making her enemy theirs.

shot.search: Straw Hats Nico Robin war government

lines.text: Only then does she cry and ask them to take her out to sea.

shot.search: Nico Robin I want to live

lines.text: People say it was just a loud stunt.
But it's the one thing that answers a fear of being a burden.
Because to Robin, a burden is someone nobody would burn a flag for.
That's why Luffy burned that flag to get one sentence out of Robin.

shot.fallback: flag burning above a crying woman
